brief.note: Earnings misses and cut guidance driving single-name crashes while indexes sit near records. Prices are latest confirmed closes.

candidates.name: Cellebrite DI Ltd.
candidates.business: Digital forensics software used by police and agencies to extract phone evidence
candidates.cause: Q2 sales grew 16% but missed estimates; 2026 growth guidance cut to 15% and Q3 to 19.5%, with net income down year on year.
candidates.right: Law enforcement budgets must hold and the guidance cut prove a one-year reset
candidates.wrong: Growth keeps decelerating, leaving a software multiple attached to a mid-teens grower

candidates.name: On Holding AG
candidates.business: Swiss premium athletic footwear and sportswear brand, sold direct and wholesale
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue of $1.05bn missed the $1.08bn expected; 2026 constant-currency growth guidance cut to low-20% from at least 23%. Worst day since listing.
candidates.right: US sell-through must recover once promotional pressure eases and wholesale sell-in normalises
candidates.wrong: Brand heat fades in a discount-led market and premium pricing stops holding

candidates.name: Upwork Inc.
candidates.business: Online marketplace matching businesses with freelance contractors, earning fees per contract
candidates.cause: Cut full-year revenue outlook to $730-750m, blaming worsening Google search referrals, weak freelance labour demand and AI automating the work it brokers.
candidates.right: AI must create more freelance projects than it automates away from the platform
candidates.wrong: AI keeps absorbing routine freelance work while Google referrals decay, shrinking the marketplace

candidates.name: Pan American Silver Corp.
candidates.business: Silver and gold miner operating across Latin America and Canada
candidates.cause: Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.73 missed the $1.04 expected as gold output lagged guidance and the effective tax rate jumped to about 37%.
candidates.right: Gold output must return to guidance and the tax rate normalise next quarter
candidates.wrong: Metal prices roll over, turning a production stumble into a sustained earnings downgrade
